description: Fuentes de agua potable en el municipio is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ayuntamiento de Vitoria-Gasteiz. The portal shows the English title as "Drinking water sources in the municipality" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ayuntamiento de Vitoria-Gasteiz. Its keywords include Azpiegiturak, Infraestructuras. The listing shows 1 download or service links in ZIP. The listing shows 2025-03-31 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.es_ES). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
